Name: AS's slight changed Greenhouse
Author: Awassakura
Description:
[b][size=6]Introduction: [/size][/b]
[size=3]A slightly modified version of the original greenhouse, featuring 225 plots of arable land and 16 fruit tree spots.
Supported in version 1.6.11.

[/size]

[size=6][b]简介：[/b][/size]

[size=3]一个稍微修改了原版温室的小型温室。有225块耕地和16个果树位置。
[/size]支持星露谷1.6.11


[size=6]How to Download: [/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and install SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install Content Patcher.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip this mod, then place it into the Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=6]如何下载：[/size]
[list=1]
[*]下载安装SMAPI。
[*]下载安装Content Patcher（常说的CPmod）。
[*]下载本mod，解压到Mods文件夹里即可。
[/list][size=3]

[/size][size=6]About：[/size]
This mod replaces the original greenhouse in the game, so it is not compatible with any mods that directly replace the original greenhouse in the game.
If you are playing SVE and using Immersive Farming, you need to turn off the greenhouse that comes with Immersive Farming in the settings(in GMGC) to make the mod compatible.
If you encounter any problems while using it, feel free to submit them in posts, and I will respond within a week at most.


关于：
这个mod替换了游戏原版的温室，所以不与任何直接替换游戏原版温室的mod兼容。
如果你正在玩SVE，使用沉浸式农场，你需要在设置中关闭沉浸式农场自带的温室，使mod兼容。
如果你在使用中遇到任何问题，都欢迎在posts中向我提交，我最长会在一周内回复。[list]
[/list]
